subject: Operational onramp checklist & milestone runway — StackBridge go-live
messages:
From: laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com
To: taylor.hughes@stackbridge.com, alicia.moreno@stackbridge.com
Cc: ben.carter@redwoodinference.com, marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
Date: Mon, 09 Jul 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Operational onramp checklist & milestone runway — StackBridge go-live

Hi Taylor & Alicia,

Thanks again for the kickoff earlier. Attached is our initial mutual action plan (MAP) workbook and a short operational checklist we put together based on today's call. I wanted to capture proposed milestones and owner assignments so we have a tight runway to the targeted production date.

High-level suggested timeline (please confirm):
- Week 1 (Jul 10–16): Network provisioning + credentials exchange — Owner: Ben Carter
- Week 2 (Jul 17–23): Test environment deployment + sample traffic — Owner: Ben Carter
- Week 3 (Jul 24–30): Integration validation & training session 1 — Owner: Marissa Cole
- Week 4 (Jul 31–Aug 6): UAT sign-off & go/no-go checklist — Owner: Laura Bennett (program lead)

Immediate asks:
1) Can you confirm your preferred go-live week (we suggested Aug 1–6)?
2) Please review the attached MAP and flag any missing dependencies (security, procurement, SSO).
3) Any calendar conflicts for the proposed training windows?

Attachments: 1) StackBridge_MutualActionPlan_v1.xlsx (MAP workbook) 2) network_requirements.pdf (network ports and VPN details)

Thanks — I can update the workbook with your feedback and publish a final milestone calendar.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Senior Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0192
From: taylor.hughes@stackbridge.com
To: laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com
Cc: ben.carter@redwoodinference.com, marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com, alicia.moreno@stackbridge.com
Date: Tue, 10 Jul 2028 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Operational onramp checklist & milestone runway — StackBridge go-live

Laura —

Appreciate the clear plan. Quick notes from our side after an internal sync:
- Go-live week: Prefer Aug 1–6 as proposed. We want a soft launch (limited users) on Aug 2 and full cutover Aug 5 if UAT passes.
- Procurement: PO should be issued by Jul 18 — Alicia is on it.
- Security: We need a short security evidence package (SOC2 items, data residency confirmation) before UAT. Can Redwood point us to the standard pack?

Ben — can you confirm the VPN and IP allowlist timelines? We want staging to be reachable by Jul 18.

A few calendar notes: our engineering lead is OOO Jul 15–18, but other engineers can support testing earlier.

Thanks,
Taylor Hughes
VP Product & Engineering
StackBridge Inc.
 taylor.hughes@stackbridge.com
(415) 555-0421

Confirming network timeline: we'll provision VPN and test IPs by Jul 16 and hand over a connectivity validation window Jul 16–18. Action items on my side:

Marissa — I'll need the test accounts and sample dataset by Jul 14 so we can run a smoke pass once staging is open. Laura — please confirm you'd like me to own the staging cutover.

2) Procurement/PO: PO will be sent by Jul 18. Please include the billing contact: accounts.payable@stackbridge.com.

We propose adding a short security checkpoint between Week 2 and Week 3 in the MAP:
- Week 2.5 (Jul 21–23): Security evidence review & sign-off — Owner: Laura Bennett + StackBridge security

Marissa — we'll share the sample dataset by EOD Jul 13 to help Ben run smoke tests.
